# Step - date_trunc

`date_trunc` · category: [Dates and times](../../traversal/step_reference.md#dates-and-times)

Truncates to a DT unit (PostgreSQL date_trunc).

## Forms

```text
date_trunc(arg1: DT)
date_trunc(arg1: DT, arg2: string)
```

## Example

```rhai,graph=modern
g.inject(date("2023-08-17")).date_trunc(DT.month).next().day   // 1
```
